## Webscrapen

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)

url <- "https://nos.nl/zoeken?q=gendergelijkheid&page=1"
nos <- read_html(url)
nos

titel <- nos |>
  html_elements(".kYBrrl") |>
  html_text()
titel

link <- nos |> html_elements("main") |> 
  html_elements("ul") |>
  html_elements("li") |>
  html_elements("a") |>
  html_attr(name = "href")
link

data <- nos |>
  html_elements("time") |>
  html_text()
data

length(titel)
length(data)
length(link)

info <- tibble(titel, data, link[1:20])

information <- info |>
  rename(Title = titel, Date = data, URL = `link[1:20]`) |>
  mutate(URL = paste0("https://nos.nl", URL))

#print(information[,"URL"])

tibble(information)
```
